other_conditions: Must be a landholder farmer family that collectively owns cultivable land (any size) as per land records
Landowner families with ROFR lands and D Patta lands are eligible
Farmers cultivating acquired lands without compensation are eligible
For joint holdings, benefit goes to the family member with the highest landholding; if tied, to the eldest member
Landless tenants must have no own agriculture/horticulture/sericulture land
Lease agreements within the family are not eligible
Minimum lease area: 1.0 acre for all crops, 0.5 acre for vegetables/flowers/fodder, 0.1 acre for betel vine
Only one cultivator per landowner family receives benefit
Only one tenant/cultivator belonging to SC, ST, BC, or Minority category per landowner family receives benefit; preference order ST, then SC, then BC, then Minority
In tribal areas, only tribal cultivators/tenants are recognized
A landless tenant with multiple lease agreements is treated as a single unit
Lease agreements with a marginal farmer residing in the same village are not entertained
Tenants cultivating Inam or endowment lands receive benefits as per recorded evidence
benefits_summary: Eligible farmer families (landowners or landless tenants) receive ₹13,500 per year in three installments, along with crop insurance, interest‑free loans, free electricity and other agrarian support.
documents_required: Land records as per Webland data
